changeSet.author: jmbabazi
changeSet.comment: IS-392, Create concept mapping View at startup
changeSet.sql: create view report_mapping as select crm.concept_id, crs.name "source", crt.code from concept_reference_map crm, concept_reference_term crt, concept_reference_source crs where crm.concept_reference_term_id = crt.concept_reference_term_id and crt.concept_source_id = crs.concept_source_id and crt.retired = 0 and crs.retired = 0 and crs.name in ('PIH','CIEL','PIH Malawi');

changeSet.author: cioan
changeSet.comment: Create the Get/Manage/Purge Patient Program Attribute Types privileges and grant them to roles. OpenMRS core guards ProgramWorkflowService with these privileges via @Authorized string literals but never creates them, so reading a ProgramAttributeType fails with "Privilege ... does not exist in the database" -- which blocks the quickprograms transferred-out form. MLW-1824

changeSet.author: mseaton
changeSet.comment: Remove duplicate htmlformentry_html_form rows (multiple rows sharing the same form_id, left over from historical re-imports) for 14 forms. Runs before Initializer's htmlforms domain loads, since that loader looks up the existing HtmlForm only by its parent Form and aborts with a duplicate-uuid error if more than one row exists for the same form. MLW-1839

changeSet.author: mseaton
changeSet.comment: drugs.csv renames this already-retired duplicate drug, but openmrs-module-initializer's CsvParser.shouldFill() skips the whole fill step (including the name change) for a Void/Retire=true row when the entity already exists - so the rename silently never applies against an existing database. Apply it directly here instead. MLW-1839
